attempts.remediation: Both combined and per-block evaluators now record the lower of the two feasible economic costs and continue to reject only a positive tie-break upper-band violation.

attempts.remediation: Checkpoint and digest writes now use same-directory temporary files, atomic os.replace, and bounded retry. The prior valid checkpoint is never opened for truncating overwrite.
